text:
90% of early-stage SaaS founders in India make this pricing mistake:

They convert their USD prices directly to INR.

$29/mo becomes ₹2,400/mo. To a Mumbai or Bangalore startup, ₹2,400 is an approval committee. ₹499 is an impulse buy on UPI.

Here are 3 rules we used to 4x conversion:
1. Anchor against local software (Tally, Zoho), not Silicon Valley tools.
2. Enable UPI AutoPay before offering credit cards.
3. Offer single-seat starter tiers under ₹999.

What is your biggest pricing hurdle in India? Let me know in the comments.
rationale: High-impact hook with concrete stat, actionable 3-point framework, local Indian context, clear comment CTA.
